reply_text:
I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to him on **November 3, 2025**.

- **Source for the date:** Moss's Coastal digest of Sun 11/2/2025 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's recap note from 2025-12-08 gives the same date.
- **Operational start:** The recap says Bettina kept running the day-to-day work through Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I said to use Nov 22 only if the CRM has a field for the operational start.
- **CRM not checked:** I couldn't see the CRM record itself. The share I can read has no CRM files, so I said the answer comes from the digest and the note.
